name: Somananda
summary: Founder-voice of the Pratyabhijna line: the Sivadrsti argues the world is Siva appearing as multiplicity, countering dualist and Buddhist accounts. Teacher of Utpaladeva (who commented on him); his Saktavijnana survives as a short work.
bio: Founder-voice of the Pratyabhijna line (c. 900): the Sivadrsti argues the world is Siva appearing as multiplicity, countering dualists and Buddhists. Pupil of Vasugupta; teacher of Utpaladeva. His Saktavijnana survives as a short work.
